Wave 2 — Attempts backend (migration 0010, attempts API, grading)
Wave 3 — Frontend apps/web (Next.js + shadcn/ui, teacher + student UI)

decisions.rationale: Working end-to-end model with real polished UI ASAP; frontend is NOT optional or deferred
Modern SaaS/EdTech appearance; shadcn primitives + CatLium-specific components on top

decisions.decision: Wave 3a (teacher UI) parallelizable with Wave 1-2 backend
decisions.rationale: Frontend can develop against already-stable APIs while backend work continues
Mark non-essential work as later/deferred rather than implementing before demo-critical vertical slice

decisions.decision: Frontend communicates ONLY with the NestJS API
decisions.rationale: Never directly calls PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, OCR, AI worker, or internal worker APIs

next_action: Implement Wave 1 (Syllabus backend: migration 0009, AI_GENERATE_SYLLABUS worker, syllabus API module) and Wave 3 (Frontend apps/web) in parallel. After syllabus backend, implement Wave 2 (Attempts backend). Then Wave 3b (student UI) after attempt APIs. Integrate and validate in Wave 4.
context_notes: CRITICAL PRIORITY: Get a working end-to-end model with a real, polished UI as soon as possible. Do NOT interpret the roadmap as requiring us to finish every backend phase before building the UI. Use a demo-first vertical-slice strategy. The entire flow must use the actual NestJS backend and database. No fake data or hardcoded success states except intentional demo seed data.
